settings.name: USE_DNSBL
settings.description: DNSBL is enabled by default; set `USE_DNSBL` to `no` to disable checks for incoming connections.

settings.name: DNSBL_LIST
settings.description: DNSBL servers: list of DNSBL server domains to check, separated by spaces.

settings.name: DNSBL_IGNORE_IP
settings.description: Space-separated IPs/CIDRs to skip DNSBL checks for (whitelist).

settings.name: DNSBL_IGNORE_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request bypass the DNSBL checks. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: DNSBL_IGNORE_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.

settings.name: DNSBL_IGNORE_IP_URLS
settings.description: Space-separated URLs providing IPs/CIDRs to skip. Supports `http(s)://` and `file://` schemes.
